note: Independent audit against RFC 4724 Section 4.2 and Section 5. TestRFC4724EstablishedGRCollisionClosesOldWithoutNotification establishes a real passive session over wire OPEN+KEEPALIVE with peer GR capability carrying 1 AFI/SAFI (local BGP ID > remote BGP ID to isolate from RFC 4271 tie-break) and proves detectCollision returns (true, true) and finishCollisionHandoff treats the subsequent connection as termination of the old TCP session (0 bytes / io.EOF on old socket, no NOTIFICATION, new connection retained). Negative subtests isolate both no-GR and 0-family empty GR capabilities (with local ID < remote ID), asserting detectCollision returns (false, false) and no-GR rejects the new connection with NOTIFICATION Cease/Connection Collision (6/7) while keeping the old session open.
